title: The Effect of Cilostazol Compared to Aspirin on Endothelial Function in Acute Cerebral Ischemia Patients

sections.abstract: Patients presenting with acute cerebral ischemic events are randomly assigned into aspirin (n=40) or cilostazol (n=40) group in a double-blinded manner. FMD is measured as a primary outcome at baseline (T0) and 90 days (T1). Serious and non-serious adverse events were described.
